newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold market quiet, dealers await direction.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold market quiet, dealers await direction.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange firmed to 930 kilos on Tuesday, from Monday's 627 kilos but remained fairly quiet as prices were static and traders were sidelined awaiting market direction, dealers said.
Gold closed unchanged in dollar terms at $345.00 an ounce, following quiet trade and only slight price movements on Europe's major markets.
Gold firmed in lira terms to 1,589,000 lira per gram, versus the previous 1,587,000 lira as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The Turkish lira closed at 143,200 to the dollar, down from Monday's close of 142,980, helping the rise in gold's lira price.
Most of the the day's trade -- 805 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 53.8 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
